description: JavaScript file containing functions for handling popup windows and data exchange in SuiteCRM, including opening popups, setting return data, and managing form submissions.

methods.name: get_popup_request_data
methods.description: Returns JSON string of popup request data.

methods.name: get_close_popup
methods.description: Returns the close_popup function or data.

methods.name: open_popup
methods.description: Opens a popup window with specified parameters for SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets form fields with data returned from popup.

methods.name: set_return_and_save
methods.description: Sets form fields and submits form to save data from popup.

methods.name: set_return_and_save_targetlist
methods.description: Sets multiple form fields, handles list view, and submits form.

methods.name: get_element_index
methods.description: Finds index of a form element by name within a specific form.

methods.name: get_initial_filter_by_account
methods.description: Constructs initial filter string based on account form data.
